messages:
Isabel: Quick pass here  aiming to harmonize a few orthography and naming things across SDK snippets in /docs/samples. Goal: small, low-risk PRs that improve discoverability.

Raj: What are the exact renames?

Isabel: Short list: local example var `result` -> `response`; prefer `model_version` when showing model identifiers in code; replace 'cache warming' with glossary term 'prefetch' in prose. Also standardize captions to sentence case (not Title Case) and prefer serial commas in lists for consistency.

Tom: Two practical asks: (1) add a tiny parenthetical under samples: (note: `response` is the client param, not the raw API payload) and (2) always include language on fenced blocks (```python, ```js). MDX playground crashes without those.

Lena: Voice nit: UI labels should read "model version" (two words). In code we keep `model_version`. Also prefer active imperatives for captions: "Fetch an embedding" vs "How to fetch an embedding".

Isabel: Good — I'll make a checklist and open three micro-PRs (py/js/go). Each PR will contain: one-sentence summary, link to tracking sheet, label set.

Raj: Labels?

Isabel: `docs:microchange`, `needs-glossary`, `voice-review`. Approvers: Lena (voice), Isabel (author), +1 eng reviewer. Target review time: 3 business days.

QA-bot: Reminder: run link-checker and mdx-lint in CI. Last run found 5 broken links under /docs/samples.

Tom: Also watch out for accidental schema renames. Keep API field names identical to the contract. Ive seen a suggested change `choices` -> `items` in examples — that's a blocker.

Isabel: Agreed. Documentation-only variable renames only. PR description will include: "examples-only rename; no API contract changes."

Lena: Micro-orthography question  do we keep Oxford comma across docs? My vote: yes, keep it. That avoids ambiguity in lists.

Raj: +1 Oxford comma. I'll run a quick grep for style violations in the samples branch before opening PRs.

Tom: Example snippet suggestion for Python (short form):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(response="Summarize the changelog", model_version="rwd-stable")
print(resp)
```

Isabel: Nice and compact. I'll mirror that in JS/Go and include an expandable "full example" that shows streaming and error handling.

QA-bot: CI note: ensure runnable snippets have placeholder API keys masked and use non-blocking timeouts in examples. Link-checker will re-run on push.

Lena: I'll do voice pass on the three PRs today. If anything feels risky I'll comment rather than block.

Isabel: Opening PRs in the next hour and will paste links here. Thanks all! :seedling:
